restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: The official menu legend distinguishes vegetarian, vegan, dairy-free, contains shellfish, contains nuts, gluten sensitive, and can be modified to be gluten sensitive.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: Positive contains-shellfish and contains-nuts icons are preserved with direct item evidence. Dairy-free and gluten-sensitive icons are supported dietary claims but are not converted into categorical allergen absence. The black M icon is a modification marker, not a milk declaration.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: CIRCA states that it is not a gluten-free environment and that individual gluten sensitivity varies.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: Preserved separately as restaurant-level gluten cross-contact context. It is not converted into blanket product mayContain labels.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: CIRCA asks guests to notify the server of food allergies or dietary restrictions; its gluten-sensitive guide says staff can make recommendations and consider preparation precautions.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: This is an accommodation statement, not a guarantee that any product is free of an allergen.

sourceAttempts.query: Inspect the official Foggy Bottom location page, all live menu tabs, dietary icons, ordering links, location map, and menu navigation for allergen, allergy, ingredients, nutrition, and cross-contact material.
sourceAttempts.outcome: The official site confirmed the exact location and complete current menu surfaces. It provides menu descriptions and links to icon-bearing PDFs, but no comprehensive product-by-allergen matrix or full ingredient table.

sourceAttempts.query: Inspect current Foggy Bottom Lunch, Dinner, Brunch, Beverage, and discoverable Gluten Sensitive PDFs plus official-domain document results for allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredient, icon, and cross-contact disclosures.
sourceAttempts.outcome: The official PDFs provide positive contains-shellfish and contains-nuts icons, ingredient descriptions, dairy-free/gluten-sensitive/modifiable dietary icons, and a restaurant-wide not-gluten-free-environment caution. No comprehensive allergen matrix was found. Visual review confirmed that the M icon means can be modified to be gluten sensitive, not milk.

sourceAttempts.query: Inspect the restaurant-linked ChowNow store for location 34562, exact address, all categories, product descriptions, item-level allergen labels, and downloadable guides.
sourceAttempts.outcome: The exact Foggy Bottom ChowNow store exposes 44 distinct current food products and descriptions. It contains no comprehensive allergen matrix or cross-contact guide; three utensil/condiment controls are service modifiers rather than products.
